purpose: Teach: 手のひら/アクセント/モーニング/出来上がり/隣人/いわく/たかが/まかせ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの手のひらに、ぼくのクッキー乗せて
lines.en: Sho, can you put my cookie on your palm?
lines.style: Bright, playful request. Lean-in energy. Voice lilts up at the end like she's inviting him into a small, shared game. Warm and conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんのアクセント面白いと思う
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think Dad's accent is really funny.
lines.style: Genuine observation, delivered without filter. Slight wonder in the voice — like he's just noticing something he wants to share. Quiet laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとモーニング喫茶、行きたいな
lines.en: Sho, I'd really like to go to a morning café with Dad.
lines.style: Wistful, half-musing. Soft landing on each phrase. Not quite asking permission, more sharing a quiet wish. Warm and a little distant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくが粘土でお皿の出来上がり、すごいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, look — I finished making a plate out of clay. It's pretty cool, right?
lines.style: Pride mixed with seeking approval. Voice brightens on 「すごい」. Eager for her reaction but not desperate — the confidence of something he made.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、隣人のお祖母様にご挨拶しようね
lines.en: Sho, let's go say hello to our neighbor's grandmother.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, warm undertone. Voice settles into a responsible register — like she's inviting him to do something kind and grown-up together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんいわく、本を読むのが楽しいって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa says reading books is really fun.
lines.style: Quiet recitation of something Grandpa said that stuck with him. Thoughtful, not rushing. A little reverence for what Grandpa believes. Soft voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、たかがゲームでケンカしちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't fight with your brother over just a game.
lines.style: Gentle but firm boundary-setting. Not harsh — more like a quiet truth she knows he'll understand. Settling tone, like closing a small door gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに宿題まかせるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to let Dad help me with my homework.
lines.style: Earnest decision, delivered with quiet confidence. Voice lands firmly on the choice. Slight warmth — like he's made up his mind and wants her to know.
